# Acquire the unchanged vendor library used by the frozen corpus regression.

# vendor's library references its original disk README for licensing terms.
set(NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/reference_models/harprmos.lib"
    CACHE FILEPATH "Pinned harprmos.lib used by the RFF70N06 regression")
set(_rff_sha256 "61469f6ff311b0c8efb6e62b037293843806ecb1b23c5de71472983628858dae")
set(_rff_url "file:///tmp/neospice-joss-checkpoint9-missing-download-input")
if(NOT EXISTS "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}")
    get_filename_component(_rff_dir "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_rff_dir}")
    file(DOWNLOAD "${_rff_url}" "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}.download"
        STATUS _rff_download_status TLS_VERIFY ON TIMEOUT 60)
    list(GET _rff_download_status 0 _rff_download_code)
    if(NOT _rff_download_code EQUAL 0)
        file(REMOVE "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}.download")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot acquire pinned RFF70N06 library: ${_rff_download_status}. Supply NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY for offline builds.")
    endif()
    file(SHA256 "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}.download" _rff_download_sha256)
    if(NOT _rff_download_sha256 STREQUAL _rff_sha256)
        file(REMOVE "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}.download")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Downloaded RFF70N06 reference library hash mismatch")
    endif()
    file(RENAME "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}.download" "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}")
endif()
file(SHA256 "${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}" _rff_actual_sha256)
if(NOT _rff_actual_sha256 STREQUAL _rff_sha256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "RFF70N06 reference library hash mismatch: ${NEOSPICE_RFF70N06_LIBRARY}")
endif()
configure_file(circuits/rff70n06_op.cir.in generated/rff70n06_op.cir @ONLY)

import subprocess,tarfile,io,tempfile,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary','HEAD','--','.',':!docs/evidence/**'])
newfiles=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\0')
for path in sorted(p for p in newfiles if p and not p.startswith('docs/evidence/')):
 r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--no-index','--binary','--','/dev/null',path],stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert r.returncode in (0,1),path
 patch+=r.stdout
output=root/'docs/evidence/joss/2026-09-10-checkpoint9-working-tree.patch'
output.write_bytes(patch)
archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','HEAD'])
base=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='neospice-joss-checkpoint9-apply-'))
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
 tar.extractall(base,filter='data')
subprocess.run(['git','apply','--check',str(output)],cwd=base,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','apply',str(output)],cwd=base,check=True)
previous=json.loads((root/'docs/evidence/joss/2026-09-10-validation-08.json').read_text())
paths=set(previous['source_file_sha256']) | {'tests/reference_models.cmake','tests/circuits/rff70n06_op.cir.in','tests/unit/test_rff70n06.cpp'}
docs=['README.md','docs/ROADMAP.md','docs/joss-progress.md','docs/validation-methods.md','docs/capabilities.md','docs/ngspice42-abort-leak.md','docs/joss-requirements-checklist.md','docs/joss-author-information.md','docs/joss-readiness-goal.md','docs/building.md','docs/rff70n06-investigation.md']
for name in sorted(paths|set(docs)):
 assert (root/name).read_bytes()==(base/name).read_bytes(),name
result=dict(base_revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip(),patch=str(output.relative_to(root)),patch_sha256=hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest(),checked_source_files=len(paths),checked_documents=len(docs),temporary_checkout=str(base),result='git apply --check and apply succeeded; reconstructed source and document bytes match the checkpoint',scope='Excludes docs/evidence contents and ignored dependencies/corpus. Does not claim a fresh build or independent installation.')
Path('/tmp/neospice-joss-checkpoint9-patch-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
